programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A criminal who kills a police officer wages war on society. In 1987 such a criminal vanished after shooting two Boston officers, one fatally. He had a history of violence against cops and the protection of a group of outlaws.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Terror In Disguise

programme.title: The FBI Files: No Remorse

programme.title: Wild Mouse

programme.title: The Good Heart

programme.title: Barefoot
programme.desc: Den "svarta får"-sonen av en förmögen familj möter en ung psykiatrisk patient som har växt upp i isolering hela sitt liv. Han tar med sig denna naiva unga kvinna hem till sin brors bröllop.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Being Kara
programme.desc: Karas liv fortsätter att snurra allt snabbare. Samtidigt hjälper en uttråkad och sörjande Mary Jane Niecy att få sitt första jobb.

programme.title: The New Edition Story: Night Three

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Storm Advisory

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Girls Night In
programme.desc: Mary Jane pratar ut med Andre och börjar fundera på sin framtid. Samtidigt uppstår friktion mellan Kara och Mary Jane när Kara gör om Marks program, och en kvinna närmar sig Paul Sr.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: The Huxtables Have Fallen

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2708

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2706

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2801

programme.title: The Hills: The Boys Of Summer

programme.desc: In rural Canada, Dr. John Schneeberger is accused of sedating and sexually assaulting one of his female patients and his step daughter. DNA tests demonstrate that the doctor is innocent, but the patient insists that he sedated and raped her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pure Evil
programme.desc: In the search for the killer of two Texas teenagers, a behavioral profile led to suspect Jason Massey. Hard science proved the profile was correct, and Massey was executed by lethal injection on April 3, 2001.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Root of All Evil
programme.desc: A suspect's former lover comes forward with a fantastic tale of murder, mutilation and cremation. But there's no way to test the story's validity — until a plant pathologist and a dendrochronologist conduct tests where the cremation supposedly occurred.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Where the Blood Drops
programme.desc: Susie Mowbray was charged in her husband's death. Her son was so convinced of her innocence that he enrolled in law school, studied all of the evidence and, eventually, discovered the truth of what really happened between his parents.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Punch Line
programme.desc: In 1994, Rhoda Nathan was found murdered in a Cincinnati hotel room. When hotel employee Elwood Jones visited the emergency room with an infected hand, which he said was cut on a dumpster, the doctor recognized the injury as something else.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sibling Rivalry
programme.desc: In 1991, San Francisco pornographer Artie Mitchell was murdered in his home. His brother and business partner, who was found near the scene carrying a rifle, later confesses to shooting Artie.The question is whether the shooting was premeditated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pastoral Care
programme.desc: In 1981, New York correctional officer Donna Payant disappeared and was later found in a landfill. The medical examiner not only identified the cause of death, but also found an important clue.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bagging a Killer
programme.desc: In 1999, 9-year-old Valiree Jackson vanished on her way to school near Spokane. Her father, Brad Jackson, reported the disappearance and the entire community started searching for her abductor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Double Trouble
programme.desc: In 1995, when off-duty Maine State Trooper Vicky Gardner is attacked by Steven Fortin during a routine stop, it triggers a chain of events which jumpstart a stalled murder case in New Jersey.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Federal Offense
programme.desc: When there's a difficult case to crack  whether it involves drugs, arson, or weapons  the investigators and scientists of the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms have the means to crack it.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Burning Evidence
programme.desc: Identifying Burned Remains: It's difficult to have a murder investigation without a body, and burning up the victim is a time-honored method of destroying physical evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Wrong
programme.desc: Hiding a body can be difficult; it's sometimes easier to obscure or disguise the circumstances of the death, turning murder into suicide, or pinning the blame on someone else. The truth is told through subtle clues taken from the crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives: True Crime
programme.desc: They know as much about crime as any crime fighter, or any criminal. They're the crime writers, and through their eyes we see murder most foul.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scattered Clues
programme.desc: There's never a good reason for murder, but some killers are particularly brutalchoosing their prey at random or with no apparent motive and then cunningly covering their tracks. Even so, telltale clues remain.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: I'm Taking Back My Man

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: A Prayer for the Dying

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Where is Claudia Jane

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Blood From A Stone

programme.desc: When a celebrity dog trainer is murdered, an heiress fears for her life and a bodyguard vows to be a hero.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Playing With Fire
programme.desc: In September 2002, two men were found executed in a burning Mercedes in an upscale Hollywood neighborhood. What initially looked like a drug-related murder, turned out to be something entirely different, but the crime scene left little evidence to go on.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Kristen's Secret
programme.desc: A report about Kristen Cunnane, a former All-American swimmer who kept quiet about years of sexual abuse by a trusted female teacher and how her decision to go public led to the revelation that she was not alone.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bodies of Evidence
programme.desc: It is difficult to convict a murderer if the body can't be found. But forensic science is finding ways to do it. Devious killers can think up many was to dispose of their victim's remains, but they are often no matches for investigators.

programme.title: iCarly: iHittar Lewberts förlorade kärlek

programme.title: iCarly: Bröllopsbesvär
programme.desc: Efter att ett iCarly-fan har friat till sin flickvän live under webb-showen, känner gänget att de måste vara med på bröllopet. Men när bruden får kalla fötter måste Carly komma till undsättning.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Arajs Kommando
programme.desc: Viktor Arajs, a Latvian, played a significant role in the Holocaust, collaborating with the Nazis to eliminate Jews. Leading the Arajs Kommando, he orchestrated the killings of around 30,000 Jews. Arajs justified his actions as patriotic defense.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Belgian Collaborator
programme.desc: Leon Degrelle, a charismatic Belgian leader, joined the Nazis and led Die Wallonien on the Eastern Front. Despite no military background, he earned the Knight's Cross for valor. He recruited 4000 more for the SS, defending Berlin until April 1945.

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution
programme.desc: Tyska befäl upptäcker effektiviteten i att gasa fångar, och Auschwitz förvandlas från ett litet bakvattenläger för de som motarbetar den nazistiska ockupationen av Polen, till ett storskaligt förintelseläger för judar.

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution
programme.desc: Höss hanterar komplikationer som uppstår från det provisoriska gaskammaren och den ökande efterfrågan då nazisterna börjar genomsöka hela Europa för fler människor att ta till Auschwitz och döda.

programme.title: The Real Oppenheimer SV

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Maia sees a vision of Jordan Collier's death. Kyle's frightening blackouts are disrupting Tom's personal life. Diana is asked to hand over Maia's diary to NTAC.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: When Tom arrives at NTAC, he learns that no one has ever heard of the 4400. Tom and Diana track down a man to a museum, and during the chase, Tom finds a mysterious lab that only he can see.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Double Trouble
programme.desc: In 1995, when off-duty Maine State Trooper Vicky Gardner is attacked by Steven Fortin during a routine stop, it triggers a chain of events which jumpstart a stalled murder case in New Jersey.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cats, Flies & Snapshots
programme.desc: When 19-year-old Lori Auker left her Pennsylvania home for work and never arrived, it took space-age technology, cat hairs and insects to pinpoint the woman's abductor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Naked Justice
programme.desc: When Leann Fletcher is found dead, investigators use blood spatter analysis and forensic computing to find a motive for her murder: her husband, a prominent lawyer, was having an affair with judge Susan Chrzanowski.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Treading Not So Lightly
programme.desc: By using techniques she saw on forensic science TV shows, a mother determines who was responsible for the accident that permanently injured her 4-year-old daughter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shopping Spree
programme.desc: When a woman and her daughter didn't return home from shopping, her husband directed police to a nearby mall. The child's body was found, but there was no sign of the wife.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Forever Hold Your Peace
programme.desc: When Chris Ochoa confessed to the 1988 rape and murder of Nancy DePriest, the case was closed. 8 years later, Achim Marino confessed to the same crime. Can DNA evidence identify the real perpetrator?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Reel Danger
programme.desc: When two boys are brutally attacked, investigators rely on evidence fished out of a nearby pond. It became the first case where diatom analysis was used to place a suspect at the scene of the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Who's Your Daddy
programme.desc: In 1988, the body of a young woman was discovered in an Ohio river. Most of the evidence had been washed away, but the victim's 6-year-old son unwittingly told investigators all they needed to know — without saying a word. The clue was in his genes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Alibi
programme.desc: In 1991, a high school girl vanished after attending a party. The prime suspect had two alibi witnesses for the night she disappeared. A solid alibi can often overcome circumstantial evidence, but forensic evidence is another matter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Purr-fect Match
programme.desc: When police discovered the body of Douglas Beamish's estranged wife, authorities linked 20 cat hairs found on her jacket to a cat owned by Beamish's parents. It was the first time animal DNA was used to solve a criminal case.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing

programme.desc: Mia bjuder med Frank på en avslappnande spa-weekend på hotell, men det blir trassel med såväl kama sutra som tarmsköljning. Casper rymmer från sjukhuset och Frank måste leta upp honom.

programme.title: Klovn: Bedragsholms Slott
programme.desc: Frank, Mia, Casper och Iben åker på en weekend-tripp till Dragsholms slott, tillsammans med Lars Hjorthøj och hans fru Tina. Kvinnorna ser fram emot en lugn och skön helg, medan grabbarna vill hänga runt och jaga, men allt spårar ur snabbt.

programme.title: Klovn: Bispebjerg-tricket
programme.desc: Frank och Mia tittar på ett hus där den förre ägarens fru är död, men kroppen aldrig hittades. Niels berättar hemligheten bakom Bispebjerg-tricket för Casper och Frank - det närmaste man kan komma sex med någon annan utan att vara otrogen.

programme.title: Klovn: Kram Och Mugg
programme.desc: Frank väntar otåligt på att vännen och kollegan Casper ska bli bättre och under tiden hjälper han Mia lite halvt i te-butiken. Plötsligt vaknar Casper till och har en ny idé. Mias 12-årige brorson är på besök och Frank tycker att de är konstiga.

programme.title: Klovn: Amatörerna
programme.desc: Frank och Mia har flyttat till landet och går på en boskapsutställning tillsammans med Casper. Dagen där på upptäcker Mia att de köpt en ko. För att lära känna lokalbefolkningen ställer Frank och Mia upp i stadens årliga skådespel.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Sexy Vampires
programme.desc: Vi får träffa en läskig asiatisk rumskompis, killarna ser närmare på den ljusa sidan av tortyr och Keegan kliver in i ett hus fullt av vampyrer.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Slap-Ass
programme.desc: Vi får se killarna ha dålig mottagning på Skype, ett slavslagsmål à la 'Django Unchained' och en basebollspelare som daskar folk för mycket i arslet.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Obama Shutdown
programme.desc: Keegan blir lite för hög, en fotbollsspelare gör allt för att få rött kort och två 'sexperter' ger råd om cunnilingus.

programme.title: Key & Peele: MMMMMM
programme.desc: Jordan och Keegan stilar inför en hängiven publik på en lokalteater, en trafikreporter får uppleva turbulens i helikoptern och ena halvan av en R&B-duo avslöjar sina känslor för den andre under ett uppträdande.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Das Negroes
programme.desc: Jordan och Keegan försöker att gömma sig inom synhåll från en jagande nazist, två slavar gör sitt bästa för att slippa från auktionen och ett par bovar stöter på en mindre motgång innan de slår till.

programme.title: Key & Peele: A Cappella Club
programme.desc: Ett inslag hjälper till att förhindra barn att bli soldater i Afrika, en a cappella-grupp i college får en ny medlem, Meegan och André går på sin första dejt, en terrorgrupp har en matbil och två gamla män diskuterar populärmusik.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The Branding
programme.desc: Jordan och Keegan undersöker hur det är att vara svart på college och vilket följe man får när man blir känd. Dessutom andra sketcher som hur ett grannskap reagerar på ett sagodjur och när man får - och inte får - säga kontroversiella ord.

programme.title: Key & Peele: East West Bowl #2
